structured.answer: I'd pick Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (קופה 13414): it's the S&P my friends talk about, it shows the highest returns on the page (13.7% over 3 years, 11.92% over 5), and the fee, 0.56%, is the same tiny number as everyone else's.

Both sound like shares and an index and both have 99% מניות. The second one shows no return, so I went with the S&P one I recognised.
There's no button or link to actually open the קופה with Harel, so I don't know what the first step is.
